methodology.formula: CO₂e (t) = distance (km) × emission factor ÷ 1,000, with weight (t) applied for rail, ocean and air.
methodology.roadBasis: Road is charged per truck run at 0.5928 kg CO₂e/km regardless of load — the workbook's own basis.
methodology.distance: 2. Sea Port distance: Ports.com 3. Airports distance: 1. Google Maps 2. www.prokerala.com/travel/airports/distance/from-hyd/to-sea/ 4. Road Ways and Railways Distance: Google Maps
methodology.factors: Road 0.5928 kg/km · Rail 0.00996 · Ocean 0.0084 · Air 1.58 kg per tonne-km, all as stated in the workbook.
methodology.boundary: First-mile collection from the growing regions, factory to inland depot, depot to gateway port, and the international sailing or flight.

assumptions: The workbook records dispatch dates only, so transit is estimated from its distances. Every transit figure is marked "est." and no CO₂e depends on one.

The workbook's last dispatch is 2024-06-30, so today is 2024-07-01 and the forward book is the FY23-24 July–September quarter rolled forward 366 days. Product, weight, gateway, container and every distance are unchanged from the real shipment — only the dates move, and each planned row carries the cell range it came from.
Route options are only offered where the workbook records every leg they use, and each shows how many shipments already moved that way.
Region and market are derived from the workbook's destination port names; product form and Scoville rating are parsed from its item descriptions.
Route options use the FY23-24 inland network. Earlier tabs record the same run as both 21 km and 645 km to "Hyderabad", so they are read for history but not used to price alternatives.
